references.text: The same command not to leave anything until morning is given for the Passover lamb: 'You shall not let any of it remain until morning.'
Moses commands the people regarding the manna: 'No one must let any of it remain until morning.'
A similar command concerning the Passover sacrifice: 'The fat of my festival offering shall not be left until morning.'
Regarding the ordination offering: 'If anything remains of the ordination meat or bread until the morning, you shall burn what is left.'
The meat of a thank offering must be eaten on the same day it is presented; nothing may remain until morning.
A thank offering must be eaten on the same day or the next day; whatever remains until the third day must be burned.
Regarding the Passover lamb: They shall not let any of it remain until morning, and they shall not break any bone in it.
